description: Run the `test_*` rules inside `*_test.rego` files within a conftest policy directory, verifying that the policies themselves are correct. Equivalent to `opa test` but using conftest's policy-loading machinery. Returns per-file pass/fail results, and NO_TESTS_FOUND when the directory holds no test rules. Requires `conftest` on PATH or `CONFTEST_BINARY` set; returns CONFTEST_NOT_FOUND otherwise.

data.description: Paths to data directories. Each must be inside an allowed root (OPA_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS).

namespace.description: Namespace to verify. Omit to verify all namespaces.

policy.description: Path to the directory containing both the Rego policies and the `*_test.rego` test files. Must be inside an allowed root (OPA_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS). Omit to use conftest's default `./policy` directory.

v0Compatible.description: Read the policies as Rego v0 (`--rego-version v0`), the syntax before OPA 1.0: rules without `if`, `deny[msg] { ... }`. conftest reads v1 by default and refuses such a policy.

name: conftest_verify
title: Conftest verify
